title: feat(spec, plugin-chatbot): AI model entries carry an optional tierLabel, and the closed model picker shows it
body:
Fixes #35578

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：AI 对话的模型选择器在收起时，若服务端给出了档位名，只显示「快速」这样的档位名，而不再显示被截断的「Fast · Claude Haiku…」；展开列表不变。今天云端尚未提供档位名，所以用户暂时看不到差别。
- 为什么做：属于 AI 对话界面体验收尾，替模型选择器收起时文字被截断的问题解决；档位名由云端 AI 服务填写，另起一张云端卡跟进。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是收起的选择器显示档位名不对或仍显示完整名称，不影响所选模型与发送；可直接撤回本次合并。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **Spec** (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`): the object arm of the `AiModelsResponseSchema` model entry gains an optional `tierLabel`, a non-empty string naming the model's tier alone, in the language the response is served in. Nothing else in the schema moves; the bare-string arm stays.
  - Name precedent: a `NOUNLabel` display string next to a plain `label`, as with `pluralLabel` beside `label` on object definitions (`packages/spec/src/data`) and `confirmLabel` and `addLabel` in the UI schemas. It is a display string, not a tier id. The tier word is operator text inside cloud's `sys_ai_model.label` (cloud ADR-0028 D5, D8; not the plan tiers on `available_for_plans`), so an id would make the open-source console carry cloud's tier names and their translations. `label` is already a server-supplied display string, so a sibling display string keeps the producer and the consumer as they are today.
  - `.min(1)`: an empty tier name is not spec-legal. This follows the `costMultiplier` precedent, where the spec states the domain and the console keeps the value only as the spec declares it.
- **Console** (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot`):
  - `ChatbotModelOption.tierLabel?` is added.
  - `useAiModels` keeps a served `tierLabel` only when it is a non-empty string, mirroring `costMultiplierOf`.
  - `ModelPicker`'s closed trigger shows `tierLabel` when the model in force carries one, and otherwise shows `label` (then the id) as before. The trigger's `title` and the open list's row keep the full `label`, so the model's name is still on hover and the choice is still made from the full names.
  - Every chat host renders this one picker: the full-page AI chat, the chat dock and the Studio copilot.
- Docs: `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` gains one sentence under **Model Picker** (the closed picker shows `tierLabel` when served), per the `ui/` docs-driven rule. This page is outside the claim's declared file surface, and the report names the addition.
- Generated: `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`, regenerated by `gen:docs`. No other artefact went stale (`check:generated`: all 14 up to date).
- Changeset `.changeset/35578-model-tier-label.md`, `patch` on `@objectstack/spec` and `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` (the kind is `none`).
- Out of scope, per the card's route: step 2, cloud `service-ai` filling `tierLabel`. The seat files that cloud card. Until it lands, the picker looks as it does today.

**Read first, by risk:**
1. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, the `inForce` / `shown` pair in `ModelPicker`. The trigger's text and its `title` now come from different values.
2. `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`, the `tierLabel` line in the model entry. This is the contract addition the L2 review weighs.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useAiModels.ts`, `tierLabelOf` in `normalize`.

## Tests

Code and tests measured at `8a2ba56c`. The head `02da5d4e` adds only the docs sentence, after which the 28 derived doc-reading families were re-run at `02da5d4e`, all with exit 0.

- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts` ("validates AI operations"): an entry with `tierLabel` parses and keeps the key. `''`, `3` and `null` are refused.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.modelPicker-11865.test.tsx`, a new top-level describe in the picker's shared harness:
  - a model with a tier name: the trigger reads the tier name only, its `title` is the full label, and the list rows are unchanged;
  - a model without one: the trigger reads its label, as before;
  - a pick from the list still writes the model id.
- `useAiModels.noAiService-12508.test.tsx`, a new top-level describe: a served non-empty `tierLabel` is kept. It is left off an entry with none, with `''`, or with a number.

## Acceptance notes

- **The key lands before its producer.** The dispatch leaves that judgement to the L2 contract review. Until cloud `service-ai` writes `tierLabel`, no response carries it, so the change is inert at runtime. Both sides are pinned: tiered, and untiered as before.
- **Display string vs tier id.** The card allowed either. A display string was chosen for the reasons under What changes: the tier vocabulary is cloud's, and the console then needs no closed tier enum and no translations for it. The contract review on this head kept `tierLabel` (7190559193). Step 2, cloud fills it: objectstack-ai/cloud#5022.
- The trigger's `title` stays the full `label`. Before this change it equalled the trigger text, and with a tier name the two now differ on purpose.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.modelPicker-11865.test.tsx`. Expect 20 passed, including "the closed picker shows the tier name alone when the model carries one".
